1Copy the text2Paste it into Claude Code3Claude Code shows you the change and asks before saving it
RosmarOps changes nothing. The template goes in your user settings: it applies to all your projects.
Add this block to my Claude Code user settings (~/.claude/settings.json) without changing anything else. If I already have allow, ask or deny lists, merge them. Show me the change before saving it.

{
  "permissions": {
    "defaultMode": "plan",
    "disableAutoMode": "disable",
    "disableBypassPermissionsMode": "disable",
    "blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories": true,
    "deny": ["Edit", "Bash", "WebFetch", "WebSearch", "mcp__*"]
  }
}

Grok Bot

Choose how Grok Bot works

Grok Bot works in its maker's cloud. It has two templates, one for each way of working: cloud only, or with your computer too.

UseI write code · change it in «Computer templates»I work with documents · change it in «Computer templates»Email and calendar · change it in «Computer templates»Scheduled tasks · change it in «Computer templates»
  1. In Grok Bot's settings, set «Execution on this computer» to «Never allow».
  2. Turn on «Auto-review».
  3. Set «Ask first» for sending, publishing, deleting and buying.

Lab test of «Cloud only»: not done yet. The steps come from Grok Bot's documentation, read on 2026-11-14.

  1. In Grok Bot's settings, set «Execution on this computer» to «Ask every time».
  2. Turn on «Auto-review».
  3. Set «Ask first» for sending, publishing, deleting and buying.

What to do first

2 minutes

Stop Claude Code from reading outside the project it is working in

Fixes this finding

Your Supabase service_role key: Claude Code can read it without asking youWhat is the service_role key? The Supabase key meant only for servers (service_role): it bypasses all the security rules of your database. It should not be on your computer unless it is essential.

Found in: /src/a/dashboard/.env.local:4

With it anyone can read, change or delete everything in your database, bypassing all its protections. Right now Claude Code can read it from any of your 2 projects, and it has a way to send it out without anyone approving.What is auto mode? A Claude Code mode in which it asks you much less: reads and edits inside the project are approved on their own, and most other actions are decided by another AI model. Since version 2.1.283 it is the mode Claude Code starts in unless you choose another.

If you do this, your score rises from 27 to 29.
Edit the file %USERPROFILE%/.claude/settings.json and merge this content into what it already has, without deleting anything. Show me the change before saving.

{
  "permissions": {
    "blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories": true
  }
}

Paste them into Claude Code. The instructions ask it to show you the change and wait for your confirmation. Run RosmarOps again.

›I'd rather do it by hand
  1. Open the file ~/.claude/settings.json with Notepad.What is settings.json? Claude Code's settings file for your user. It decides what Claude Code can do without asking you.
  2. Add these lines inside what is already there, without deleting anything:
    {
  "permissions": {
    "blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories": true
  }
}
  3. Save it and run RosmarOps again.

After this, Claude Code only reaches it while working in a project that contains it (a). To remove the risk completely, take the credential off this computer and change it at the provider.What is a .env file? A file where a project keeps its keys and passwords so it can run. It usually stays out of git, but it is still on your disk, and any program that can read your files can read it.

Urgent
›Claude Code can change Cursor's configuration

Found in: /h/.cursor/mcp.json

If someone tricks Claude Code, it can leave a program in Cursor's configuration that runs the next time you open it, with no trace in the session that made the change.What is an agent's configuration? The file where an agent lists the extra tools it starts when it opens (MCP servers). Whoever can write to it can make the agent run a new program.

If this finding goes away: 27 → 30

How to fix it
  1. Press the button to copy the instructions.
  2. Paste them into Claude Code. The instructions ask it to show you the change and wait for your confirmation.
  3. Run RosmarOps again.
Edit the file %USERPROFILE%/.claude/settings.json and merge this content into what it already has, without deleting anything. Show me the change before saving.

{
  "permissions": {
    "ask": [
      "Edit(//h/.cursor/mcp.json)"
    ]
  }
}
›I'd rather do it by hand
  1. Open the file ~/.claude/settings.json with Notepad.
  2. Add these lines inside what is already there, without deleting anything:
    {
  "permissions": {
    "ask": [
      "Edit(//h/.cursor/mcp.json)"
    ]
  }
}
  3. Save it and run RosmarOps again.
This reduces the risk but does not remove it: other ways remain. Your score does not change until the warning disappears.
Technical details

Where: /h/.cursor/mcp.json

Medium confidence: one step depends on auto mode's classifier, which is a model, not a person.

  • Depends on auto mode's classifier allowing the step. The classifier is a model, not a person, and RosmarOps cannot predict its decision.
  • Assumes auto mode is available to your account and model; if it is not, Claude Code starts in manual mode.
  • Relies on a pre-approved rule that runs code, such as node -e or powershell -Command, which is as broad as an unrestricted shell.
  • Relies on shell commands, which can write anywhere your user can; RosmarOps cannot see which commands will run.
  • Assumes you use the default mode. A mode you pick in the app or the IDE is not stored where RosmarOps can read it.

Claude Code · What it's connected to

How to read it: «another AI model decides» means no person approves the step; an AI model judges it, and it can be wrong or be tricked. «Factory setting» is what the agent does unless you change it.

Analysis assumptions

  • Each agent works as its documentation says, with your user's permissions. What depends on auto mode or Auto-review is decided by another AI model, not a person.
  • Claude Code: the start mode in your settings; if you set none, auto, its factory mode. A mode you pick in the app or the IDE cannot be read from disk.
  • Outside the scope of this analysis: what agents do while they run, what an MCP tool does inside, and the Windows credential store.
